correctness.rationale: The open-image condition f(up x)=up f(x) together with isotonicity is equivalent to being continuous and open in the upset topology. Images of maximal points are maximal. For q>=2, any lower-to-upper image v forces all upper images equal v; then openness at any lower-to-lower point would require q different upper images, impossible; hence the map is the upper constant c_v. Otherwise every lower image remains lower and openness at any lower forces the upper restriction to permute all q maxima, while the lower restriction is arbitrary. When q=1 the top is fixed and each lower can map to any point. Composition of T_p x S_q with q constants and counts p^p q!+q, (p+1)^p follow; idempotents from choosing fixed subsets. Independent exhaustive all-function checks for 1<=p,q<=3 separately evaluated order and openness and idempotent counts.
residual_risks: No all-p,q proof follows merely from the nine finite examples; the symbolic case split supplies universal quantifiers.
